_about: The studio's scenes (media/studio/assets/engine.js). Each storyboard shot names one scene and fills only its slots, with words taken from the project's own facts.

monument.use: The project name set huge, cropped by the frame. Opens or closes a film.

slots.name: the project name, exactly
slots.line: optional, up to 12 words saying what it is

statement.use: One sentence set large. A hook, a claim, or the problem.

number.use: A real number counted up, with what it means.

slots.value: one of the project's stats values, exactly
slots.label: 4 to 12 words saying what the number means

screen.use: A real screenshot of the product opening like a shutter.

split.use: Screenshot on one side, a title and a sentence on the other.

terminal.use: A real command typed into a terminal, with its output. Only for projects that have a command.

slots.lines: 1 to 3 short output lines taken from the facts

list.use: Three or four things it does, each taking the stage in turn.

stack.use: The tools it is built with, flashed like a type specimen.

slots.items: 3 to 7 names from the stack, exactly

field.use: A flat field of colour with a few words: a chapter break.

marquee.use: One phrase running past the edges in two rows.

end.use: The end card and still image: name, one line, link. Always last.
